description: This Java source file defines the CustomRestrictionsFragment class, which extends PreferenceFragment. It is part of an Android app demonstrating custom app restriction settings integration with restricted profiles. The class manages various preference inputs (checkbox, list, multi-select), retrieves and updates restriction entries, and communicates restrictions via intents.

classes.name: CustomRestrictionsFragment
classes.description: A PreferenceFragment subclass that manages custom app restriction settings, including initializing preferences, retrieving existing restrictions, and updating restriction entries in response to user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preference UI from XML, sets change listeners on preferences, and retains instance state.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves existing app restrictions, initializes preference states based on restrictions, and prepares the result intent with current restrictions.

methods.name: onPreferenceChange
methods.description: Handles updates to preferences, reflects changes in restriction entries, and updates the result intent with the new restrictions.
